# Sweep Capital Group

> Futures trading education from Johns Creek, Georgia: The Course ($1,000 one-time) and Course + Coaching ($1,500 one-time). A written, risk-first process built on Session Sweep, the 5-15 Gap, and Power of 3. Education, not financial advice; no results are promised.

Sweep Capital Group is a futures trading education and mentorship company founded and owned by Mac Moore. It does not manage client money and does not sell trade signals.
